selected_script.angle: Warm soapy rag on a greasy oven exterior glass door turns cooking splatter into cloudy streaks, then Liapu enters naturally to cut the same oily film and leave a clear no-residue wipe test.
selected_script.hook: This soapy rag is just making my oven door look cloudier.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of greasy yellow-brown cooking splatter and fingerprints on an oven exterior glass door; a warm soapy rag wipes across it but leaves cloudy streaks.
timeline.3-6s: The same rag keeps wiping harder on the same oven glass and handle area, visibly spreading the oily film into wider smears and causing mild frustration.
timeline.6-10s: Liapu enters naturally, sprays the same smeared area, wipes with a clean paper towel, then proves the clear result with a finger glide and side-by-side dirty edge versus cleaned patch before a light CTA.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical 9:16 TikTok-style UGC cleaning-product ad, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a normal American home kitchen with natural indoor light, slight hand shake, real focus breathing, no studio polish. Use the provided product reference image as the exact product identity: Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser, white smooth plastic cylindrical spray bottle, translucent bottle body with visible liquid level, yellow front-center label reading CLEAN UP KITCHEN OIL STAINS and NET: 500ml, trigger sprayer mechanism with nozzle, ergonomic grip shape, standard 500ml proportions. Preserve product color, label placement, shape, material, texture, proportions, nozzle structure, bottle structure, and visible details exactly. Do not invent accessories, extra buttons, lights, ports, decorations, different packaging, different bottle shape, or product drift.

Timeline inside this single 10-second video:
0-3s: Extreme close-up on the outside glass of an oven door near the handle, showing realistic yellow-brown greasy cooking splatter, oily fingerprints, and a cloudy film. A woman’s hand uses a warm soapy kitchen rag, an ordinary familiar cleaning method, wiping across the glass. The rag moves once across the stain but the grease does not come off; it leaves a dull gray cloudy streak and pushes oil to the edge. Camera stays very close so the failed wipe and smeared film are obvious. Natural spoken UGC line: “This soapy rag is just making my oven door look cloudier.”
3-6s: Continue on the exact same oven glass area. The hand wipes harder with the same damp soapy rag in small circles and then straight passes, but the oily film visibly spreads wider around the handle area. Show effort and mild frustration: the rag bunches up, the hand pauses, the glass looks streakier with soap residue and greasy haze. Keep it credible and physical, no magical effects, no exaggerated chemical reactions.
6-10s: The Liapu spray bottle enters naturally from the side, held by the same hand, label facing camera briefly and clearly without a posed product-only shot. The nozzle points at the same smeared oven glass area and sprays 2 quick pumps onto the greasy film. A clean white paper towel wipes the exact same sprayed area with firm realistic pressure. The grease lifts visibly onto the towel and the glass underneath becomes clear and reflective. Finish by tilting the phone slightly to show a credible before-after contrast in the same frame: one narrow dirty cloudy edge remains beside the freshly cleaned transparent patch, plus a quick finger glide over the clean area showing no greasy drag. End with the product held near the cleaned oven door, label still accurate and visible, light natural CTA spoken: “If your kitchen grease keeps smearing, try Liapu.”

Visual requirements: real handheld phone-shot UGC, close-up cleaning demonstration, ordinary kitchen background, believable grease removal, real wiping action, no cuts that imply magical cleanup, no oversized foam, no sparkling special effects, no bacteria graphics. Product must remain stable and identical to the reference image across every frame. The product is a kitchen cleaning spray only.

Forbidden: no UI, no TikTok interface, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no captions, no floating claims, no arrows, no icons, no split-screen layout, no poster design, no invented accessories, no product drift, no magical instant cleanup, no exaggerated chemical bubbling, no harsh smoke, no color-changing effects. Only the real product label text may appear because it is part of the bottle.
